name: Chain Chon Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Chain Chon Industrial Co., Ltd., based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, operates as a prominent manufacturer and global supplier of stainless steel products. The company handles the processing and commercialization of a wide array of stainless steel forms, including hot and cold rolled coils, sheets, plates, and strips. Their offerings extend to specialized items such as patterned plates, structural elements like angle and flat bars, and welded H-beams, alongside polished finishes for coils and sheets, and other metallic materials. These versatile stainless steel products are deployed in a vast spectrum of applications. They are essential for industrial uses such as chemical storage tanks, piping systems, industrial plant components, machinery parts, and laboratory equipment. In the construction sector, they contribute to building structures, infrastructure projects, escalators, diverse flooring solutions (including non-slip and engineering stairs), and decorative elements like reflection mirrors. Furthermore, their materials are integral to manufacturing medical equipment, aviation components, various kitchenware, food processing apparatus, and automotive hardware. The firm was established in 1980.
